concept.title: Hierarchical structure
concept.abstract: This chapter explains DITA’s multi-layered hierarchical model, covering structural hierarchy in maps, content hierarchy across topic types, and element hierarchy within individual topics. It demonstrates how parent-child relationships, topic sequencing, and nested XML structures create modular yet context-aware documentation that supports navigation, publishing, information retrieval, and AI-driven content understanding. The chapter also illustrates how hierarchical organization guides users from conceptual understanding to task execution, reference lookup, troubleshooting, and terminology discovery.
